title: Purple Lightning Warrior Poses
description: A four-panel sequence showing a muscular dark-skinned female warrior with short silver hair performing a dynamic combat move. She wears a revealing purple and white armored outfit with leaf-like details, purple boots, and arm wraps as purple electrical energy crackles and intensifies between her outstretched hands.
